name: Filipe Taborda
tagline: I build web and mobile products.
summary:
Hey 👋🏼



I am Filipe Taborda, a senior frontend engineer from Portugal 🇵🇹, based in Lisbon.


I started as a full-stack developer (Angular, Node.js, Java) and today I focus on web and mobile frontend with React, React Native and TypeScript. At Bosch I work on the PRO360 ecosystem.


I care about quality: maintainable, well-tested code, with validation at the centre of the process. I also explore AI-assisted development tools and workflows to ship better software, faster. 🚀



Life begins at the end of your comfort zone. - Neale Donald Walsch
